verdict.rationale: The only provider-sourced speed figure is an informal HN comment from what appears to be Cerebras staff, saying the DFlash2 draft model has been seen to 'break 300 tok/s' (cerebras-comm-6). First-party docs only describe TTFT-improving techniques (payload optimization) and Prometheus latency metrics for dedicated endpoints, with no published numbers. Missing for 10: first-party published tokens-per-second/latency figures per model, formal benchmark methodology or results, a load-testing guide, and independent benchmark corroboration.
